title: onychium multisectum
intro: Onychium multisectum, commonly known as Chinese restharrow, is a plant species belonging to the family Asparagaceae. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat a variety of health conditions, including fever, cough, and rheumatism, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and improving respiratory function. The bioactive constituents of Onychium multisectum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
